exercise.name: Reverse Barbell Wrist Curl
library_steps: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, palms down, wrists past your knees.
Lift the backs of your hands up as high as you can.
Lower the bar slowly, moving only your wrists.
exercise.one_line_summary: Seated, both forearms along the thighs palms down with the wrists past the knees; the wrists drop the bar, then lift the backs of the hands. Wrist extensors on the back of the forearm do the work.

setup.target: Both forearms on the thighs, palms down, wrists just past the knees.

muscles.anatomy: Extensor carpi radialis longus and brevis, extensor carpi ulnaris
muscles.emg: Not measured in this exercise; loaded wrist extension raised extension strength 79 % (TY10).
muscles.role: Lift the back of the hand.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: The elbows or forearms move as the wrist works.
mistakes.why_it_matters: The wrist muscles must do the lift alone.

sources.citation: Tyler TF, Thomas GC, Nicholas SJ, McHugh MP. 2010. Addition of isolated wrist extensor eccentric exercise to standard treatment for chronic lateral epicondylosis: a prospective randomized trial. J Shoulder Elbow Surg.
sources.what_it_gave: Isolated loaded wrist-extensor exercise raised wrist and finger extension strength 79 % vs 15 % in a randomized trial.

sources.citation: Walkowski AD, Goldman EM. 2023. Anatomy, Shoulder and Upper Limb, Forearm Extensor Carpi Radialis Brevis Muscle. StatPearls (NCBI Bookshelf).
sources.what_it_gave: Extensor carpi radialis brevis: superficial back-of-forearm muscle from the lateral epicondyle, the prime wrist extensor.

clip_check.check: Bar lowered, then lifted by the wrists
